graphs.mobile: 2x4 NHWC, eight channels, pointwise -> ReLU6/requant -> zero-padded spatial depthwise 3x3 -> ReLU6/requant -> pointwise -> projection rescale and residual
graphs.attention: eight tokens, eight features per head; QK transpose -> scale and stable per-row fixed-point exponential softmax -> PV -> output rescale

timing: Per-invocation graph latency, both mcycle reads in same harness, from before input and weight packing to after final output consumed by the caller. Include both full accelerator dispatches, host middle and final arithmetic. Data fixture provisioning and untimed independent checks excluded. No DMA in the two reduced graphs.

comparison.A: pinned lowering, full setup for both launches
comparison.D: same linked C ELF, all changed pointer fields after producer await and before audited host middle
comparison.E: best measured strict subset of changed pointers before the producer await in the same C layout; enumerate masks 1 through 6, plus D=0 and C=7 as endpoints

weights: fixed synthetic int8 coefficient fixtures, seeded; their graphs preserve dataflow and execute actual operators. Independent untuned graph instances, not pretrained accuracy or whole applications.
decision_note: Report both candidate existence and practical system value. Label within-family masks as an empirical oracle. Never fill unsupported workloads with modeled cycles.
